claude.result:
`subtrack add "Meal kit" 59.90 --every week` now works. All 36 tests pass, including new ones for the weekly cost and charge dates. I also ran it by hand: the meal kit shows €259.57 a month and renews on 29 Oct for a plan that started 1 Oct. I left a scratch file at `/tmp/wk-r1.json` that you can delete.

- **Weekly cost:** the monthly cost is price × 52 ÷ 12, so €12 a week shows €52.00 a month. `list`, `total`, `add` and `export` all show it.
- **Weekly renewals:** weekly plans charge every 7 days from `--since`, and `renewals` lists them like any other plan.
- **Rounding:** monthly costs now round to the nearest cent, so the €119.99 yearly plan shows €10.00 a month.
- **Other files:** `src/export.js` had its own copy of the cost calculation and now uses the shared one. `src/store.js` now keeps `weekly` plans when it reads the file; before, it would have turned them into monthly ones. The usage text, the error message for `--every` and the README are updated too.

I also fixed an existing bug in `renewals`. It sorted by the short label ("2 Nov") instead of the date, so a charge on 29 Oct would have come after one on 3 Nov. It now sorts by date, and a test covers it.

I rewrote one old test that expected costs to be cut off at the cent (`11999` yearly → `999`) to match the new rounding.
